DWP statistical work programme

The statistical work programme outlines developments to releases of DWP Official Statistics.

From:
Department for Work and Pensions
Published:
19 August 2021
Last updated:
27 August 2026 — See all updates

Documents

Statistical work programme

HTML

Changes made to DWP statistics since April 2025

HTML

Changes made to DWP statistics between April 2020 and March 2025

HTML

Details

This statistical work programme provides information on planned changes to Department for Work and Pensions (DWP) statistics and changes under development.

Updates to this page

Published 19 August 2021

Updated the information about 'Benefit sanctions statistics' and 'Universal Credit statistics' in section 5 (Quality of our statistics).     Updated the 'Statistical work programme' document. Added information about 'Universal Credit Work Capability Assessment experimental statistics' to the table in section 4.   38. 9 May 2023

  40. 23 February 2023

  49. 28 June 2022
